name: Sarega Gurudas
reason: Moorfields Eye Hospital ophthalmology record is coherent with the vision bolt-on project: nearly all work concerns retinal disease, diabetic retinopathy, vision impairment, and SMART-India, including the SMART-India diabetes vision-prevalence study.

name: Sayem Ahmed
reason: The record is a coherent health-economics and global-health portfolio, including quality-of-life, willingness-to-pay, cost-effectiveness, health insurance, and healthcare-system research. Its Nepal hypertension cost-effectiveness protocol supports compatibility with developing a Nepal EQ-5D-5L value set.

name: Seungjin Bae
reason: Ewha Womans University record is predominantly coherent in health economics, pharmaceutical policy, and quality-of-life research. Examples include cost-effectiveness, health-care data in South Korea, cancer medicine pricing, biosimilar uptake in Korea, and AI in health-economic evaluation, consistent with a Korean EQ-5D-Y valuation study.

name: Shankar Prinja
reason: PGIMER health-economics and health-systems profile is strongly coherent with the India valuation projects. It includes the exact 2022 Value in Health article developing the Indian EQ-5D-5L value set, alongside India-focused economic evaluation and healthcare financing work.

name: Shitong Xie
reason: This is a coherent health-utility measurement and valuation record with Jing Wu, Feng Xie, and John Brazier. It includes Chinese SF-6Dv2 valuation and psychometrics, EQ-5D-5L population norms and measurement-property comparisons, and adolescent health-measurement work, directly fitting the China EQ-5D-Y projects.
